messages:
maria: Quickstart refresh — need a quick sync on local dev hot-reload + Docker auth plugin. I opened a docs PR that consolidates the auth steps for Docker/local dev and adds a `--watch` section for hot-reload. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 Can reviewers please check the code snippets (Python & Node) and the Dockerfile/docker-compose examples?

sam: Looking now. Biggest ask: make the auth flow consistent across SDK examples. We should prefer `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var and provide an alternate `rdw login --dev` command. Also verify token formatting in the Python snippet.

jon: +1. Also add a 1-paragraph migration note for folks coming from SDK v3 -> v4: `Client(auth=...)` -> `new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`. I can draft that.

carla: Found a small typo in the Node sample — `RedwoodClient` should be `Redwood`. Will leave an inline comment on the PR.

maria: Thanks everyone. I also added a `docker-compose.override.yml` example for local dev with volume mounts and env file. Snippet below:```yaml
version: '3'
services:
  web:
    build: .
    volumes:
      - .:/app:cached
    env_file: ./.env.dev
    command: npm run dev
```

sam: Small nit — consider `.env.local` naming convention, but `.env.dev` is ok. Please also add a note to run the dev server with `--host 0.0.0.0` when running inside Docker so the container is reachable from the host.

docs-bot: link-checker: ran on PR 4567 — 2 broken links detected: line 82 (old auth guide), line 145 (intro image).

maria: Fixed both in latest commit and pushed. Also added the migration blurb Jon suggested: "If you're upgrading from SDK v3, replace `Client(auth=...)` with `new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`."

jon: Can we add a short troubleshooting FAQ for 'auth errors with Docker'? Something like: check that the `.env` file is included via `env_file`, verify file permissions so the container can read it, and ensure `ARG`/`ENV` in the Dockerfile don't overwrite the runtime env.

carla: LGTM after those fixes. @sam @jon can you approve so we can merge and stage in Thursday's docs deploy?

sam: I'll approve now :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks! Tagging #eng-devex for visibility in case any SDK snippet changes are needed.

deploy-bot: docs preview built: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-4567 (staging) — visual diff shows updated quickstart and new Docker examples.

jon: Quick follow-up: add `rdw login --dev` as an explicit alt to env var in the "first-run" checklist — improves local DX.

maria: Added that note and did a small copy edit. Marking PR ready to merge.

maria: (final) Thanks everyone — merging after any final thumbs.
